source.check: names and divisions read from the News-Letter's printed list of unopposed Unionist nominations, 24 April 1924

note: Reconstitution of Irvinestown rural district council. Thirteen Unionist candidates were nominated for the nineteen divisions and, there being no Nationalist nominations, were returned unopposed; no candidates came forward for Aghamuldoney, Belleek, Innismacsaint, Lattoon, Ederney or Castlecaldwell (Belfast News-Letter, 24 April 1924). Unopposed Unionist nomination. Returned unopposed.
